_comment: Hand-curated seed for the off-patent drug intelligence engine. Includes per-country geo_coverage, LOE timelines, and export eligibility. LOE dates are publicly reported estimates and should be refreshed via FDA Orange Book / EMA / India IPO APIs in later phases.

molecules.notes: Keytruda — Merck. FDA Purple Book (BLA 125514 / BLA 761391). Injectable (IV solution; Subcutaneous Qlex) — mAb (Humanized IgG4-kappa anti-PD-1). Primary LOE: Late 2028 – 2029; Thicket Horizon: 2033 – 2042+. Thicket strategy: 40+ indication method patents, subcutaneous Qlex switch co-formulated with hyaluronidase, fixed-dose combination (FDC) patents (TIGIT/LAG-3).

Darzalex / Darzalex Faspro — J&J / Genmab. FDA Purple Book (BLA 761036 / BLA 761143). Injectable (IV infusion; Subcutaneous Faspro) — mAb (Human IgG1-kappa anti-CD38). Primary LOE: 2026 – 2029; Thicket Horizon: 2031 – 2035+. Thicket strategy: Conversion to subcutaneous Darzalex Faspro via ENHANZE (rHuPH20) technology, multiple myeloma combination regimens (VRd, Dara-Pd), orphan drug extensions.

Opdivo — Bristol Myers Squibb. FDA Purple Book (BLA 125554). Injectable (IV solution; Subcutaneous formulation) — mAb (Fully human IgG4 anti-PD-1). Primary LOE: Late 2028; Thicket Horizon: 2036 – 2038. Thicket strategy: Subcutaneous reformulation switch, dual-checkpoint blockade combinations (Yervoy), extended dosing interval patents (Q2W/Q4W).

Tagrisso — AstraZeneca. FDA Orange Book (NDA 208065; RLD/RS). Solid Tablet (Film-coated, oral) — Small Molecule (3rd-gen EGFR TKI; mesylate salt). Primary LOE: August 2032; Thicket Horizon: 2035 – 2042. Thicket strategy: Crystalline mesylate salt form claims, adjuvant EGFR+ NSCLC indications, mutation subgroup treatment methods (T790M/L858R).

Imfinzi — AstraZeneca. FDA Purple Book (BLA 761069). Injectable (IV infusion) — mAb (Fc-engineered human IgG1-kappa anti-PD-L1). Primary LOE: 2030 – 2031; Thicket Horizon: 2033 – 2038+. Thicket strategy: Dual checkpoint combination patents with Imjudo (tremelimumab), layered indication claims across SCLC, uHCC, and biliary tract cancers.

Verzenio — Eli Lilly. FDA Orange Book (NDA 208788; RLD/RS). Solid Tablet (Film-coated, oral) — Small Molecule (CDK4/6 inhibitor; free base). Primary LOE: September 2031; Thicket Horizon: September 2031. Thicket strategy: Single PTE-extended core patent, polymorph and salt claims, global family filings covering 45+ jurisdictions.

Kisqali — Novartis. FDA Orange Book (NDA 209101; RLD/RS). Solid Tablet (Film-coated, oral) — Small Molecule (CDK4/6 inhibitor; succinate salt). Primary LOE: 2028 – 2031; Thicket Horizon: October 2036. Thicket strategy: Dense 24+ patent web: succinate salt forms, high-load tablet strengths, pediatric extensions, combination treatment methods with endocrine therapies.

Ibrance — Pfizer. FDA Orange Book (NDA 207400 / NDA 208271; RLD/RS). Solid Capsule (Hard gelatin) & Solid Tablet (Film-coated, oral) — Small Molecule (CDK4/6 inhibitor; isethionate salt). Primary LOE: March 2027; Thicket Horizon: March 2027. Thicket strategy: Capsule-to-tablet formulation switch (solid dispersion removing food effect), polymorph claims, Paragraph IV litigation settlement agreements.
Peptide injectable with massive demand but complex IP and device thicket. Most mid-tier small-molecule CDMOs are poorly positioned unless they partner on peptide fill/finish.
Large-market biologic; LOE expected late 2028. Device/formulation patents extend commercial risk. Requires biologics capability.
Mature, commoditized API. No relevant patent barriers. High NSQ alert history informs quality risk premium.
Off-patent hormonal oncology oral solid. CDSCO NSQ data shows dissolution and uniformity risks.
Off-patent PPI enteric-coated tablet. High humidity sensitivity; strong QbD fit for existing simulator.
Off-patent PPI delayed-release tablet. Volume oral solid opportunity with known dissolution failure modes.
Off-patent PPI MUPS tablet. Pellet integrity and compression force are critical quality attributes.
Off-patent ARB oral solid. Known CDSCO dissolution failures due to alkalizer distribution.
Off-patent biguanide extended-release tablet. Large volume, well-understood matrix formulation risks.
Off-patent sulfonylurea micro-dose tablet. Uniformity of content is the dominant NSQ failure mode.
Off-patent calcium channel blocker oral solid. Hydrolytic and transesterification degradation drive assay failures.
Off-patent ARB oral solid. Film-coat sintering and core degradation are common NSQ defects.
Off-patent ACE inhibitor oral solid. Diketopiperazine cyclization is the key degradation pathway.
Off-patent beta-blocker oral solid. Hydrate-state transitions affect dissolution.
Off-patent statin oral solid. Acid-catalyzed lactonization impurity is the dominant NSQ defect.
Off-patent statin oral solid. Photo-oxidation and discoloration are the key stability risks.
Off-patent DPP-4 inhibitor oral solid. Bilayer interface degradation is a known failure mode.
Off-patent DPP-4 inhibitor oral solid. Hygroscopic cyclization degradation drives assay loss.
